descriptors.name: repo_status
descriptors.title: Repository status
descriptors.description: Return workspace root, current branch, HEAD and short Git status.

descriptors.name: repo_tree
descriptors.title: Repository tree
descriptors.description: List files and directories inside the workspace with depth and entry limits.

descriptors.name: repo_root_tree
descriptors.title: Repository root tree
descriptors.description: List files and directories at the real workspace root. Equivalent to repo_tree with path=".".

descriptors.name: repo_root_redaction_status
descriptors.title: Repository root redaction status
descriptors.description: Return root listing redaction and hidden/protected-path aggregate counts without exposing hidden or protected entry names.

descriptors.name: repo_read_file
descriptors.title: Read repository file
descriptors.description: Read a UTF-8 file inside the workspace, optionally using a line window. Returns SHA-256 hashes for safe follow-up writes.

descriptors.name: repo_file_stats
descriptors.title: Repository file stats
descriptors.description: Return filesystem metadata for a workspace file or directory, with optional SHA-256 for safe follow-up reads/writes.

descriptors.name: repo_bulk_inspect
descriptors.title: Bulk repository inspect
descriptors.description: Mix up to 64 read, search and stat operations in one bounded read-only call with per-item failure isolation.

descriptors.name: repo_read_file_chunks
descriptors.title: Read repository file chunks
descriptors.description: Read a UTF-8 file in line chunks for large-file navigation. Returns chunk metadata and nextCursor.

descriptors.name: repo_diff_files
descriptors.title: Diff repository files
descriptors.description: Return a unified diff between two workspace files using the canonical IO diff engine.

descriptors.name: repo_search_text
descriptors.title: Search repository text
descriptors.description: Search text or regex inside the workspace and return matching lines.

descriptors.name: repo_find_symbol_usages
descriptors.title: Find repository symbol usages
descriptors.description: Find textual usages of a symbol in the workspace with whole-word defaults, matching the LLM-B find_symbol_usages workflow.

descriptors.name: repo_symbol_search
descriptors.title: Search repository symbols
descriptors.description: Search functions, classes, exports, variables and types in the workspace using the canonical IO symbol search.

descriptors.name: repo_file_outline
descriptors.title: Repository file outline
descriptors.description: Parse a workspace file and return symbols, imports, exports, outline and optional top comments for navigation.

descriptors.name: repo_create_file_plan
descriptors.title: Plan repository file creation
descriptors.description: Read-only plan for creating a UTF-8 workspace file. Does not create or modify files.

descriptors.name: repo_patch_plan
descriptors.title: Plan repository patch
descriptors.description: Read-only exact-string patch plan for one workspace file. Does not modify files.

descriptors.name: repo_quarantine_file_plan
descriptors.title: Plan repository file quarantine
descriptors.description: Read-only plan for moving one workspace file into reversible MCP quarantine. Does not move files.

descriptors.name: repo_move_file_plan
descriptors.title: Plan repository file move
descriptors.description: Read-only plan for moving or renaming one workspace file. Does not move files.

descriptors.name: repo_index_refresh_plan
descriptors.title: Plan repository index refresh
descriptors.description: Read-only plan for refreshing the shared Copilot IO index. Does not build or mutate the index.

descriptors.name: mcp_validation_plan
descriptors.title: Plan MCP validation
descriptors.description: Plan validation escalation; defaults to inspect-first and no validator.

descriptors.name: repo_index_status
descriptors.title: Repository index status
descriptors.description: Return availability and freshness metadata for the shared local IO/FTS/symbol index.

descriptors.name: repo_index_build
descriptors.title: Build repository index
descriptors.description: Build or refresh the shared local IO index for a workspace path. This updates only the local Copilot SQLite index.

descriptors.name: repo_index_search
descriptors.title: Search repository index
descriptors.description: Search the shared FTS5 index when available, with cursor pagination and include/exclude glob filters.

descriptors.name: repo_index_find_symbol
descriptors.title: Find repository symbol in index
descriptors.description: Search persisted symbols in the shared local index. Use after repo_index_build for fast navigation.

descriptors.name: repo_find_imports
descriptors.title: Find repository imports
descriptors.description: Find imports or dynamic imports by module source in the shared local index.

descriptors.name: repo_find_orphan_imports
descriptors.title: Find orphan repository imports
descriptors.description: Parse a workspace file or directory and report local relative or #copilot imports whose target file cannot be found.

descriptors.name: repo_index_invalidate
descriptors.title: Invalidate repository index path
descriptors.description: Invalidate a workspace file or directory in the shared local IO index after edits.

descriptors.name: repo_working_set
descriptors.title: Repository working set
descriptors.description: Open and reuse one bounded repository working set across context, symbol lookup and delta refresh without repeated scans/reads.

descriptors.name: git_status
descriptors.title: Git status
descriptors.description: Return the current Git branch, HEAD and short status for the workspace.

descriptors.name: git_diff
descriptors.title: Git diff
descriptors.description: Return a unified Git diff for the workspace or for one path.

descriptors.name: git_log
descriptors.title: Git log
descriptors.description: Return recent Git commits for the workspace.

descriptors.name: git_branch_info
descriptors.title: Git branch info
descriptors.description: Return current branch and upstream tracking information.

descriptors.name: git_stage_plan
descriptors.title: Plan bounded Git stage
descriptors.description: Validate explicit workspace paths and enumerate the exact changed files that bounded staging would affect.

descriptors.name: git_stage
descriptors.title: Stage explicit Git paths
descriptors.description: Stage only the explicitly supplied, policy-validated workspace paths. Never performs git add -A or implicit dot staging.

descriptors.name: git_commit_plan
descriptors.title: Plan Git commit
descriptors.description: Return staged files, diff stat, current HEAD and configured Git identity before creating a commit.

descriptors.name: git_commit
descriptors.title: Create bounded Git commit
descriptors.description: Commit the already-staged Git index without amend, signing overrides, arbitrary flags or additional staging.

descriptors.name: git_push_plan
descriptors.title: Check upstream Git push
descriptors.description: Resolve only the current branch upstream and perform git push --dry-run without accepting a remote, refspec or force option.

descriptors.name: git_publish_changes
descriptors.title: Stage, commit and optionally push explicit changes
descriptors.description: Governed one-call publish path: stage only explicit workspace paths, commit from a clean initial index, and optionally push only the current branch to its existing upstream.

descriptors.name: git_push
descriptors.title: Push current branch to configured upstream
descriptors.description: Push the current branch using only its existing upstream. Force, arbitrary remotes and arbitrary refspecs are impossible through this tool.

descriptors.name: project_doctor
descriptors.title: Project doctor
descriptors.description: Return basic runtime, workspace and script information for the copilot MCP project.

descriptors.name: run_typecheck_copilot
descriptors.title: Run Copilot typecheck
descriptors.description: Start the canonical strict typecheck job for src/copilot.

descriptors.name: run_lint_copilot
descriptors.title: Run Copilot lint
descriptors.description: Start the canonical lint job for src/copilot and unit tests.

descriptors.name: run_unit_copilot
descriptors.title: Run Copilot unit tests
descriptors.description: Start the canonical full unit test job for src/copilot.

descriptors.name: mcp_run_safe_validation_suite
descriptors.title: Run safe MCP validation suite
descriptors.description: Run a fixed broad validation suite. Escalation-only for cross-cutting risk or release gates.

descriptors.name: run_project_doctor
descriptors.title: Run project doctor
descriptors.description: Return the Copilot MCP project doctor report.

descriptors.name: run_copilot_validator
descriptors.title: Run Copilot validator
descriptors.description: Run one allowlisted validator or batch up to 8 validator requests in one call. Batch defaults sequential to avoid CPU/memory contention.

descriptors.name: job_list
descriptors.title: List validator jobs
descriptors.description: List active and recent validator jobs, including persisted manifests.

descriptors.name: mcp_last_validation_summary
descriptors.title: Last MCP validation summary
descriptors.description: Return the latest persisted job per validator without starting validation.

descriptors.name: mcp_validation_dashboard
descriptors.title: MCP validation dashboard
descriptors.description: Return compact validation status without starting jobs or long logs.

descriptors.name: job_get_summary
descriptors.title: Get job summary
descriptors.description: Return compact status for one validator job; no log output.

descriptors.name: job_get_output
descriptors.title: Get job output
descriptors.description: Read a bounded validator-job log tail and status.

descriptors.name: job_cancel
descriptors.title: Cancel job
descriptors.description: Cancel an attached running validator job.

descriptors.name: llmb_live_readiness
descriptors.title: LLM-B live readiness
descriptors.description: Run the canonical read-only Model Gateway/terminal LLM-B readiness audit. Does not start the terminal or call providers.

descriptors.name: llmb_live_runs
descriptors.title: LLM-B persisted live runs
descriptors.description: Read persisted Model Gateway terminal live scenario summaries from SQLite. This never calls a provider.

descriptors.name: llmb_live_test_cancel
descriptors.title: Cancel detached LLM-B live test
descriptors.description: Cancel one allowlisted detached LLM-B live harness by its strict run id after verifying the manifest pid still belongs to that exact harness.

descriptors.name: llmb_live_test_plan
descriptors.title: Plan canonical LLM-B live test
descriptors.description: Build an allowlisted live harness invocation and state whether it can consume GitHub Copilot AI Credits or BYOK/provider quota.

descriptors.name: llmb_live_test_run
descriptors.title: Run canonical LLM-B live test
descriptors.description: Run the fixed canonical LLM-B live harness. Defaults to control-only; real model/provider usage requires confirmModelUsage=true.

descriptors.name: mcp_client_latency_evidence
descriptors.title: Client TTFT evidence
descriptors.description: Record or summarize sanitized client-observed ChatGPT latency evidence such as submit-to-first-token TTFT. Stores timings and closed experiment labels only; never prompts, completions, HAR bodies, URLs, IPs, cookies or tokens.

descriptors.name: mcp_latency_attribution
descriptors.title: MCP latency attribution
descriptors.description: Attribute perceived ChatGPT/MCP slowness across local MCP handlers, result/context pressure, Cloudflare tunnel health, fixed OpenAI reachability probes, and official aggregate status evidence without claiming visibility into the ChatGPT client/model control plane.

descriptors.name: mcp_latency_dashboard
descriptors.title: MCP latency dashboard
descriptors.description: Return a compact read-only latency/SLO dashboard from in-process MCP tool metrics, including slow tools, slow phases and recommended next actions.

descriptors.name: mcp_latency_pulse
descriptors.title: MCP latency pulse
descriptors.description: Return a tiny no-I/O timing pulse for controlled repeated measurement of ChatGPT/model/orchestrator round-trip gaps at the MCP origin boundary.

descriptors.name: mcp_openai_endpoint_latency
descriptors.title: OpenAI endpoint latency observer
descriptors.description: Measure fixed OpenAI/ChatGPT endpoints from the DevContainer using fresh HTTPS connections, decompose DNS/TCP/TLS/TTFB/total latency, compare against bounded local history, and optionally persist a sanitized snapshot. It never measures ChatGPT UI TTFT or accepts arbitrary URLs.

descriptors.name: mcp_round_trip_analytics
descriptors.title: MCP round-trip analytics
descriptors.description: Incrementally sync the append-only MCP audit into a rebuildable SQLite index and return compact round-trip, recovery, preflight and workflow-pressure analytics in the same call.

descriptors.name: mcp_tool_payload_audit
descriptors.title: MCP tool payload audit
descriptors.description: Measure tools/list wire bytes and rank the largest descriptors without network calls.

descriptors.name: mcp_dependency_outdated
descriptors.title: Audit root dependency updates
descriptors.description: Compare the root package dependencies with npm registry latest versions using the fixed local npm-check-updates workflow. No arbitrary package, registry, command, cwd or environment input is accepted.

descriptors.name: mcp_dependency_upgrade
descriptors.title: Upgrade root dependencies to latest
descriptors.description: Upgrade every root dependency/devDependency reported by npm-check-updates to the npm registry latest tag using the packageManager-pinned npm version. Lock resolution disables lifecycle scripts; the final install enables them and runs fixed native-binding smoke checks. Requires explicit confirmation and never accepts arbitrary packages or commands.

descriptors.name: mcp_cleanup_ai_artifacts
descriptors.title: Cleanup MCP AI artifacts
descriptors.description: Delete a bounded set of strict UUID-named validator artifacts beyond retention. Rollback sidecars can be purged only by explicit request while automatic rollback is disabled; OAuth, tunnel, pid and quarantine state stay unreachable.

descriptors.name: mcp_maintenance_plan
descriptors.title: MCP maintenance plan
descriptors.description: Return the safe batched maintenance actions available for this MCP server, with risk and default behavior.

descriptors.name: mcp_maintenance_apply_safe_fixes
descriptors.title: Apply safe MCP maintenance fixes
descriptors.description: Run a fixed allowlisted batch of MCP maintenance actions. Defaults to dryRun=true and never accepts arbitrary shell commands.

descriptors.name: terminal_exec
descriptors.title: Execute arbitrary terminal commands
descriptors.description: Execute any shell command or executable permitted by the MCP process OS identity. Supports one-shot or batched execution, arbitrary cwd/env/stdin, optional no-timeout mode, bounded output tails, and process-group termination. No command allowlist is applied.

descriptors.name: terminal_session_control
descriptors.title: Control persistent terminal sessions
descriptors.description: Open and control arbitrary persistent shell/process sessions. Supports backend=auto|pipe|pty, stdin writes, EOF, resize for PTY, signals/process groups, graceful close and forgetting closed sessions. PTY is used automatically when node-pty is installed.

descriptors.name: terminal_session_read
descriptors.title: Read persistent terminal sessions
descriptors.description: Read/list/status persistent MCP terminal sessions and inspect terminal capabilities without mutating a process. Output reads are cursor-based and bounded so long-running terminals do not require repeated full-log transfers.

descriptors.name: delegate_to_repo_autonomy_runner
descriptors.title: Delegate to repo autonomy runner
descriptors.description: Run or dry-run a fixed local autonomy mission; no arbitrary shell, paths, or destructive actions.

descriptors.name: mcp_golden_prompts
descriptors.title: MCP golden prompts
descriptors.description: Return the canonical real-ChatGPT prompt set and measurement schema for authorization/blocking experiments.

descriptors.name: mcp_apps_sdk_readiness
descriptors.title: MCP Apps SDK readiness
descriptors.description: Inspect this MCP server for Apps SDK widget/CSP metadata, Company Knowledge search/fetch readiness, and prompt-friction implications.

descriptors.name: search
descriptors.title: Search Company Knowledge
descriptors.description: Search the bounded local Company Knowledge corpus. Read-only; returns only id, title and url for fetchable workspace documents.

descriptors.name: fetch
descriptors.title: Fetch Company Knowledge
descriptors.description: Fetch one document previously returned by Company Knowledge search. Read-only; the id must be a repo:* result id.

descriptors.name: mcp_devcontainer_network_posture_audit
descriptors.title: DevContainer network posture audit
descriptors.description: Read-only audit of DevContainer DNS/network artifacts relevant to MCP Cloudflare Tunnel latency and reliability.

descriptors.name: mcp_devcontainer_network_control_plane_refresh
descriptors.title: Refresh DevContainer network state
descriptors.description: Run only the canonical passive network-control-plane-state.sh summary action with fixed arguments, timeout and output bounds, then return a fresh posture audit. It performs no external network probes and accepts no caller command or path.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_config_audit
descriptors.title: Cloudflare MCP config audit
descriptors.description: Read Cloudflare zone settings and config rules for the MCP hostname, reporting browser/security/product settings that may interfere with OAuth, JSON-RPC or streaming MCP clients.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_plan_capabilities_audit
descriptors.title: Cloudflare plan capabilities audit
descriptors.description: Read-only Cloudflare plan capabilities audit for MCP edge policy changes.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_edge_backup_create
descriptors.title: Cloudflare edge backup create
descriptors.description: Persist a local JSON backup of the current Cloudflare tunnel, DNS, rulesets and policy diff before any edge mutation.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_edge_backups_list
descriptors.title: Cloudflare edge backups list
descriptors.description: List local Cloudflare edge snapshot backups created before Cloudflare edge changes.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_edge_audit
descriptors.title: Cloudflare edge audit
descriptors.description: Read Cloudflare zone rulesets for the MCP hostname and report sanitized cache, WAF, rate-limit and transform risks for remote MCP clients.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_edge_policy_apply
descriptors.title: Cloudflare edge policy apply
descriptors.description: Plan or apply the canonical Cloudflare edge policy with mandatory backup. Defaults to dryRun and requires confirmApply=true for real mutation.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_edge_policy_diff
descriptors.title: Cloudflare edge policy diff
descriptors.description: Compare the actual Cloudflare edge ruleset audit with the desired plan-only MCP edge policy and return non-mutating gaps.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_edge_policy_plan
descriptors.title: Cloudflare edge policy plan
descriptors.description: Return the plan-only desired Cloudflare edge policy for MCP cache bypass, OAuth token protection, anonymous MCP protection and non-interference invariants.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_edge_snapshot
descriptors.title: Cloudflare edge snapshot
descriptors.description: Return a consolidated read-only Cloudflare snapshot with tunnel, DNS, edge rulesets and policy diff for rollback planning.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_metrics_snapshot
descriptors.title: Cloudflare metrics snapshot
descriptors.description: Read the local cloudflared Prometheus metrics endpoint and return a compact operational snapshot for the MCP tunnel.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_post_change_gates
descriptors.title: Cloudflare post-change gates
descriptors.description: Run a read-only gate bundle after Cloudflare tunnel/origin/edge changes: tunnel status, remote audit, metrics and pass/fail recommendations.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_transport_benchmark_plan
descriptors.title: Cloudflare transport benchmark plan
descriptors.description: Build a read-only plan for a controlled Cloudflare Tunnel transport benchmark across quic, auto and http2 profiles.

descriptors.name: mcp_host_block_diagnostics
descriptors.title: MCP host block diagnostics
descriptors.description: Classify a ChatGPT host-side MCP block and return lower-friction replacement tools plus a stable audit template. Does not persist anything.

descriptors.name: chatgpt_connector_profile
descriptors.title: ChatGPT connector profile
descriptors.description: Return the canonical ChatGPT connector form values, tunnel checklist, OAuth posture, HTTP/2+ posture, and smoke prompts for this repo MCP server.

descriptors.name: claude_connector_profile
descriptors.title: Claude connector profile
descriptors.description: Return the canonical Claude custom connector form values, OAuth notes, Cloudflare HTTP/2+ checks and smoke prompts for this repo MCP server.

descriptors.name: chatgpt_connector_url_check
descriptors.title: Check ChatGPT connector URL
descriptors.description: Validate that a candidate ChatGPT connector URL is HTTPS, canonical and ends with /mcp.

descriptors.name: chatgpt_connector_current_url_status
descriptors.title: Current ChatGPT connector URL status
descriptors.description: Return the currently saved ChatGPT connector URL, validation, tunnel age, OAuth readiness and HTTP/2+ posture without requiring the client to pass a public URL.

descriptors.name: mcp_auth_profile
descriptors.title: MCP auth profile
descriptors.description: Return the current MCP auth mode, protected resource metadata, scopes, WWW-Authenticate challenge preview, environment templates and rollout gates.

descriptors.name: mcp_oauth_issuer_diagnostics
descriptors.title: MCP OAuth issuer diagnostics
descriptors.description: Check OAuth authorization server well-known metadata readiness for ChatGPT/MCP without exposing secrets or fetching local/private hosts by default.

descriptors.name: mcp_connection_readiness
descriptors.title: MCP connection readiness
descriptors.description: Return one consolidated read-only readiness report for ChatGPT/Claude connector setup, OAuth metadata, Cloudflare tunnel state, HTTP/2+ posture and smoke gates.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_remote_audit
descriptors.title: Cloudflare remote tunnel audit
descriptors.description: Read the remotely-managed Cloudflare tunnel configuration and return compact sanitized drift/readiness evidence.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_skip_audit
descriptors.title: Cloudflare MCP skip audit
descriptors.description: Read Cloudflare skip and config posture for MCP/OAuth routes, reporting whether a skip rule is needed or a narrower configuration rule should be preferred.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_mcp_passthrough_plan
descriptors.title: Cloudflare MCP passthrough plan
descriptors.description: Return the read-only desired http_config_settings rule for MCP/OAuth passthrough without applying Cloudflare changes.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_mcp_passthrough_diff
descriptors.title: Cloudflare MCP passthrough diff
descriptors.description: Compare the desired MCP passthrough http_config_settings rule with current Cloudflare config audit results without applying changes.

descriptors.name: mcp_cloudflare_mcp_passthrough_apply
descriptors.title: Cloudflare MCP passthrough apply
descriptors.description: Plan or apply the single scoped MCP passthrough http_config_settings rule. Defaults to dryRun and requires confirmApply=true for real mutation.

descriptors.name: repo_patch_batch_plan
descriptors.title: Plan repository patch batch
descriptors.description: Plan a bounded batch of exact-string repository patches without modifying files. Repeated paths are evaluated sequentially against one virtual file state.

descriptors.name: repo_apply_patch_batch
descriptors.title: Apply repository patch batch
descriptors.description: Dry-run or apply a bounded exact-string patch batch. Real writes require confirmBatch=true; repeated paths are sequential and atomic per file. Direct apply defaults to independent per-target atomic progress without a duplicate global preview; global-preflight remains opt-in when all-target preview gating is desired.

descriptors.name: repo_apply_file_batch_plan
descriptors.title: Plan repository file batch
descriptors.description: Read-only plan for a bounded batch of workspace file operations. Does not modify files; use before repo_apply_file_batch to reduce high-risk prompts.

descriptors.name: repo_apply_file_batch
descriptors.title: Apply repository file batch
descriptors.description: Apply a bounded ordered batch of workspace file operations in one tool call. Supports create, move, quarantine, metadata-only executable-bit repair and explicit removal. Safe non-destructive sequences default to direct sequential apply; remove_file and overwrite moves retain a conservative whole-batch preflight unless applyMode is explicitly chosen.

descriptors.name: repo_write_file
descriptors.title: Write repository file
descriptors.description: Replace the full content of an existing UTF-8 workspace file. Returns hashes and a unified diff preview.

descriptors.name: repo_create_file
descriptors.title: Create repository file
descriptors.description: Create a new UTF-8 workspace file. It fails if the file already exists and returns a creation diff preview.

descriptors.name: repo_apply_patch
descriptors.title: Apply repository patch
descriptors.description: Apply a controlled exact-string patch to one workspace file. Returns hashes, line/byte deltas and a unified diff preview.

descriptors.name: repo_move_file
descriptors.title: Move repository file
descriptors.description: Move or rename one workspace file. Destination overwrite is disabled unless overwrite and confirmOverwrite are both true.

descriptors.name: repo_list_quarantine
descriptors.title: List quarantined repository files
descriptors.description: List files currently known to the MCP quarantine area, including restored and restorable items.

descriptors.name: repo_inspect_quarantined_file
descriptors.title: Inspect quarantined repository file
descriptors.description: Inspect metadata and current stored-object state for one item created by repo_quarantine_file.

descriptors.name: repo_quarantine_file
descriptors.title: Quarantine repository file
descriptors.description: Move one workspace file to a reversible MCP quarantine area instead of deleting it. Returns a quarantineId for restore.

descriptors.name: repo_restore_quarantined_file
descriptors.title: Restore quarantined repository file
descriptors.description: Restore a file previously moved by repo_quarantine_file. Destination defaults to the original path and overwrite requires explicit confirmation.

descriptors.name: repo_remove_file
descriptors.title: Remove repository file
descriptors.description: Delete one workspace file. Requires confirm=true and always returns prior hash/size; rollback snapshot metadata is available only when automatic I/O rollback is explicitly enabled.

descriptors.name: copilot_sessions_list
descriptors.title: List Copilot sessions
descriptors.description: List active Copilot SDK/LLM-B sessions known in this process without starting a new session.

descriptors.name: copilot_session_get
descriptors.title: Get Copilot session
descriptors.description: Return read-only metadata for one active Copilot SDK/LLM-B session by id.

descriptors.name: mcp_capabilities_summary
descriptors.title: MCP capabilities summary
descriptors.description: Return a compact capability decision surface; request details only for the full tool manifest and guidance.

descriptors.name: mcp_oauth_friction_audit
descriptors.title: MCP OAuth friction audit
descriptors.description: Diagnose OAuth reauthentication risk, metadata alignment, token lifetime policy, and host approval boundaries for this MCP server.

descriptors.name: mcp_session_profile
descriptors.title: MCP session profile
descriptors.description: Return a compact task-first ChatGPT operating profile for this repo MCP session.

descriptors.name: mcp_autonomy_power_score
descriptors.title: MCP autonomy power score
descriptors.description: Return a deterministic autonomy score for the ChatGPT connector based on tool coverage, annotations, metadata, auth posture and validation readiness.

descriptors.name: mcp_tools_status
descriptors.title: MCP tools status
descriptors.description: Return compact MCP tool counts, risk classes and approval strategy without repeating the full tools/list registry.

descriptors.name: mcp_smoke_workspace
descriptors.title: MCP workspace smoke
descriptors.description: Run a read-only end-to-end smoke suite over the workspace MCP surface.

descriptors.name: mcp_tunnel_status
descriptors.title: MCP tunnel status
descriptors.description: Return the current Cloudflare tunnel mode, permanent connector URL, temporary fallback state and recovery guidance.

descriptors.name: mcp_connector_smoke_refresh
descriptors.title: Refresh MCP connector smoke
descriptors.description: Run the canonical Cloudflare/OAuth connector smoke for the permanent MCP URL and persist the compact readiness state.

descriptors.name: mcp_post_restart_readiness
descriptors.title: MCP post-restart readiness
descriptors.description: Return a compact post-restart readiness snapshot for the permanent Cloudflare MCP connector before ChatGPT starts heavier work.

descriptors.name: mcp_reload_plan
descriptors.title: Plan controlled MCP reload
descriptors.description: Plan a detached restart of the managed MCP HTTP origin plus Cloudflare tunnel using only allowlisted transport profiles.

descriptors.name: mcp_reload_status
descriptors.title: Read MCP reload status
descriptors.description: Read the fixed persisted state of the most recent controlled MCP reload request.

descriptors.name: mcp_reload_schedule
descriptors.title: Schedule controlled MCP reload
descriptors.description: Schedule an allowlisted detached MCP/tunnel restart after this tool response is returned. No arbitrary command, path or environment override is accepted.

descriptors.name: mcp_runtime_health
descriptors.title: MCP runtime health
descriptors.description: Return MCP runtime health, workspace root, uptime and per-tool metrics.
